## Appearance

In his youth, he was characterized by delicate, refined features and a halo of naturally curly chestnut hair, though his hair was also described as brown. By the age of sixteen, these chestnut curls had been replaced by close-cropped brown locks. As he grew into adulthood, he developed a tall, splendid frame reaching six feet, while retaining his very dark blue eyes.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v3 ch.People P13](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0013), [v3 ch.Revelation P2](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0002), +1 more_

## Personality

Paul Irving is a remarkably imaginative and clever child who possesses his own world of "dream-people." Described as a genius and a perfect gentleman, he is naturally clean, well-mannered, and exceptionally manly. He also shows a caring, protective side by defending younger students at school and teaching them games.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P5](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0005), +1 more_

## History

Paul Irving moved from the [States](../codex/places.md#states) to live with his grandmother in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), three years after his mother passed away. He became a bright, imaginative pupil under schoolteacher [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), quickly establishing himself as her favorite student by sharing his vivid compositions, letters, and tales of imaginary shore friends. Paul formed a close bond with [Anne](../character/anne.md), visiting local cemeteries with her to place flowers on graves and joining her on visits to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There, he connected deeply with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) over their shared imaginative nature. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) helped reunite Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), Paul discussed their upcoming wedding and romantic future with [Anne](../character/anne.md). Over time, Paul turned his creative thoughts into verse, becoming a published poet whose work appeared in magazines. Years later, he returned to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as a guest to celebrate the wedding of [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), +493 more_

## Quotes

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--paul-irving.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Paul's schoolteacher, but their bond quickly grows into a close friendship as he becomes her favorite pupil. They bond deeply over a shared love of imagination, beauty, and nature, often exchanging whimsical stories and wild flowers. Paul regularly confides his creative ideas to her, while [Anne](../character/anne.md) provides him with warm mentorship and encouragement.

- Friend of — teacher and student friendship  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P1](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0001), +4 more</sub>

### [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-irving--paul-irving.md)

[Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) is Paul's grandmother who raises him in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). While she enforces strict household rules that Paul occasionally complains about, she takes care of him and provides a home while his father is away.

- Relative of — grandmother  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), +4 more</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--paul-irving.md)

[Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) is Paul's father. Paul maintains a close connection to him through letters and conversations, eagerly discussing his life and eventual romance as his father plans to reunite with and marry Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md).

- Child of — father  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)

Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Paul are kindred spirits who share a deep imaginative connection. Meeting through [Anne](../character/anne.md), they spend time together in Miss Lavendar's garden sharing stories of imaginary figures, finding a natural, joyful comfort in each other's fanciful worldviews before she marries his father.

- Friend of — kindred spirits sharing stories and imagination in the garden  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)</sub>

### [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--paul-irving.md)

[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) resident who holds a warm fondness for young Paul. She enjoys hearing about his unique personality and brightens at his imaginative stories, viewing him with fond indulgence.

- Friend of — fond of the young boy  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

### [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--twin-sailors.md)

The [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) are imaginary rock characters that Paul created in his mind. He enjoys inventing fantastical seaside adventures with them, though he explicitly clarifies in his writing that they are just fictional tales.

- presumed Friend of — imaginary rock people who come ashore to talk with him  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
